1.

O God our Father, good and gracious, God of all grace and truth, Who hast sent Thy Son, Thy true image, To us with the message of grace. He hath put the enemy to shame And proclaimed to us Thy Father’s name.

2.

As Man He hath glorified Thee, Magnified Thy name; He hath offered Himself upon the cross, A spotless sacrificial Lamb. He hath thus fulfilled all Thy will, That we might enjoy Thy presence.

3.

Thou hast shown the depth of Thy love, Its length and height and breadth; In Christ and His work for us Thy wisdom now is seen. Thy power and glory we behold In Thy Son’s resurrection.

4.

Thou hast exalted Him who suffered here, To the height of glory; He is Lord of all lords, And the joy of all heavens. In the clouds He cometh soon again And taketh His gathering home.

5.

Soon Israel and all peoples Shall render Him homage, And kings from every land Shall bow the knee to Christ. His glory shall then be widely spread Among the children of men on this earth.
